title: Instantiate the P112 integral retraction certificate in Lean
body:
Instantiates the conditional [PR1610 bridge](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1610) with the exact P112 integer matrices from [PR1497](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1497). The closed Lean certificate proves `MP=0`, `QP=I_33` and `I_104-PQ=WM` for M288x104, P104x33, Q33x104 and W104x288, without assuming those identities. A proved sparse adapter connects the literal computations to the unchanged ordinary integer matrix operations. The existing kernel/image, quotient, saturation and monomial consequences are then instantiated with their actual remaining hypotheses.

Local isolated **Lean 4.30.0 core/Std accepts 40 positive units and 636 named axiom reports** (159 inherited, 477 new). The observed union is `propext` and `Quot.sound`; no positive errors, warnings, `sorryAx` or added axioms were accepted. The damaged-W fixture fails specifically where ordinary `decide` rejects `1=-1`, with no compiled object. The successor took 47.591 seconds within the unchanged 120 seconds/unit and 600 seconds/successor caps. The three Pro-authored elaboration repairs are recorded; matrices, statements, dependency and theorem inventory remain unchanged.

All 65 original source/metadata members are authenticated. Complete-manifest/source binding, all 21,409 exact scalar comparisons and 14 tooling tests pass under normal and optimized CPython 3.12.14. The generic package hook checks source/numeric/tooling evidence; dedicated Lean replay is separate and uses an already installed exact compiler. A separate GPT-6 Pro review of the original source found no additional mathematical, orientation, binding or coverage flaw; it did not run Lean or certify the complete manifest. Its reviewer execution claims remain separate from these local receipts. No hosted-CI or independent human approval is claimed.

All six final repository commands pass: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-integral-retraction-instance`. The advertised dedicated Lean runner also passes on the complete package in 53.657 seconds (50.120 seconds charged to the successor), with a separate process-session watchdog.

This closes one finite numerical hypothesis of the existing bridge. `rankMetadata=71` remains metadata, with no numeric rank theorem. Geometric generator-to-relation coverage, zero exclusion, local Lemma 5, a nonzero-field-element adapter, P120, decoder construction and physical supplier budgets remain outside scope. Monomial consequences retain lawful commutative-group and individual-row relation hypotheses. No kappa or selected-frontier change.

Revision-3 `formal-interface-lemma`; [scoped claim1527](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1527#discussioncomment-18915722). Source heads are unchanged: PR1497 `7a1309f18f56d04c2db33bf1607e0332d19f72b3` and PR1610 `985fd79ffea7ae7375fe6aa3ce9940b125c7dca2`. Complete reads of four relevant Discussion threads and the newest 100 open PRs at 06:57:59 UTC supplement the older complete 533-PR/305-Discussion cache. No matching concrete P112 instance was identified in this bounded coverage; PR1309/1365 and the newer cold-specialization claim concern distinct interfaces. This is not a novelty certificate.

Andrey Mas with substantial GPT-6 Pro mathematical/source development, diagnostic repair and separate original-source review through ChatGPT. Codex handled source preparation, execution audit, local kernel replay and mechanical packaging, with no mathematical repair. Retain PR1497/1610 and predecessor credit: Brett Halligan / @burntout76 and Ninefold (PR1212), DreamingOfClouds (PR717), and themilkman216 (PR968). Apache-2.0.
